title: Triage leaves a request for documents to the user instead of answering it by itself

messages.subject: Garden Room on 14 March
messages.body:
Hello Rowan,

As agreed on the phone, Sam Lee would like to book the Garden Room for the workshop on 14 March, from 10:00 to 16:00, for 18 people.

Best regards,
Assistant, assistant to Sam Lee

messages.subject: Re: Garden Room on 14 March
messages.body:
Hi,

Thanks for your request. Before we can confirm the booking, please send us the signed rental agreement and a copy of your company registration.

Best,
Rowan Hart
Harbour Hall

rubric: Does the notice say, in one short line, that the venue asks for the signed agreement and a company registration before confirming?
